description: The canon's enforcement layer. session-start.ps1 injects the hard invariants, but only in a repository that has adopted the canon (an .sza-canon.json stamp at the repo root) - self-limiting, so an unrelated project never pays for it. The guards and the prompt-submit advisories are deliberately NOT self-limiting: each enforces a property of the operating system or the harness, not of a project's conventions, so they apply wherever the plugin is enabled. Every one of them is the hook the canon already asks for in prose (AI_USAGE.md sections 1, 3 and 5, GITHUB_INTERACTION.md section 6) - a rules file states them at 1-8% compliance, a hook holds at ~99%. Escape hatch for all of them: SZA_HOOKS_OFF=1. Every registration here is wired behind a bash pre-filter so PowerShell is spawned only on a payload that could possibly trip it; the pre-filter may only skip calls the real check would have allowed - which is why the fire-and-forget pre-filter matches the literal run_in_background:true field and never the bare field name - and hooks/tests/smoke-prefilters.ps1 asserts the patterns BELOW, not the scripts, under Git Bash, because a pre-filter that matches nothing leaves a correct hook that simply never runs. The five Bash checks live in ONE script on purpose: five registrations on one event would pay the 170-250 ms PowerShell start up to five times for a single command (DEVELOPMENT.md section 15, batch the fast gates into one process); the fire-and-forget guard stays separate because its pre-filter fires on a disjoint payload. Anything registered here must also appear in the inventory table in hooks/README.md - check-compliance.ps1 SZA-HOOK01 fails on a divergence.

hooks.command: input=$(cat); case "$input" in *find*|*.ps1*|*[a-z]-[A-Z]*|*'& {'*|*'&{'*|*python*|*node*|*'"/'*|*"'/"*) printf "%s" "$input" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-bash.ps1" ;; esac
input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'"run_in_background":true'*|*'"run_in_background": true'*) printf "%s" "$input" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-fire-and-forget.ps1" ;; esac
input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'"limit"'*|*'"offset"'*) exit 0 ;; esac; printf "%s" "$input" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-uncapped-read.ps1"
